key.name: enabled
key.description: Whether the colour filter is currently applied to the screen.

key.name: filter
key.description: The colour filter that is applied to the screen.

key.name: strength
key.description: The strength of the colour filter, between 0 (no filtering) and 1 (full filtering).

key.name: tint-color
key.description: The colour applied by the tint filter, as an 8-digit hexadecimal colour in the #rrggbbaa format (e.g. #ff0000ff for opaque red or #80ff0000 for semi-transparent red). The alpha channel is the opacity of the tint.
